name: generate_columns_beams
author: hprebar
title: Generate Columns and Beams from Centerlines
description: Creates native Revit Structural Columns and Structural Framing beams along Grasshopper centerlines with assigned FamilySymbol and Level.
notes: Places Structural Columns at given point coordinates and Structural Framing along line vectors.

columnPoints.description: Array of 3D points in meters for column base locations.

beamLines.description: Array of 3D line endpoints in meters for beam centerlines.

columnHeight.description: Default column height in meters if unattached.
